# Disguised letters, then harmless sentences with digits, times and contractions.

Oh sh1t, the cave is dark.
What the fu-ck is that?
Do not k.i.l.l the bee.
The Ki11er Bee is here.
I have 3 cats and 10 dogs.
Room 101 is warm.
Hi! It is a well-made box.
Do not ki'll the bee.
He'll be home at 4:55.
Room 455 is up, and we'll go at 10:15!
She'd say it's fine. I'm sure they're right, but we can't stay.
